title: MAFFS personnel join wildfire suppression efforts against Wiley and Jerry Ridge Fires in Northwest United States
description: A U.S. Air National Guard C-130H aircraft assigned to the 302nd Airlift Wing departs the Klamath Falls Airtanker Base to provide aerial fire fighting surge capabilities to the U.S. Forest Service during their Modular Airborne Fire Fighting System (MAFFS) mission, Aug. 9, 2023. This year marks the 50th anniversary of the trusted and valued partnership between the Department of Defense and the U.S. Forest Service. Air Forces Northern, U.S. Northern Command’s Air Component Command, is the DoD’s operational lead for aerial military support to the National Interagency Fire Center, assisting with wildland fire suppression operations when requested. (U.S. Air Force photo by Master Sgt. Nieko Carzis)
